title: Post Quantum CISA: Signature Aggregation for Bitcoin’s Future
description:
📌 Learn more about this talk on GitHub: ⭐️🐙
https://github.com/TABConf/7.tabconf.com/issues/106

🧬🟠 Cross Input Signature Aggregation (CISA) has been on the Bitcoin wishlist for years
But with small elliptic curve signatures, the savings usually weren’t worth a soft fork 🤷‍♂️

⚛️🔐 Post quantum signatures change the math
They’re bigger, so the efficiency gains from aggregation start to matter a lot more 📦💥

🧠⚙️ This talk explores a new variant of CISA that works with any signature scheme
Including post quantum
Helping reduce the impact of larger signatures without increasing block size 🧱✅

📉📏 It’s a space saving idea that could make post quantum signatures more practical and efficient for Bitcoin’s future 🚀
